purpose: Append-only chronological history of verified Estate Audit Manifest snapshots with neutral transition diffs.
rules: Each timeline entry contains one complete valid Estate Audit Manifest.
Entry sequence numbers are contiguous beginning at 1.
Manifest asOf timestamps must increase strictly across entries.
Each entry after the first records previousManifestSha256 equal to the immediately preceding manifest hash.
Each entry after the first contains the deterministic Estate Manifest Diff from the previous manifest to the current manifest.
The stored transition diff must exactly equal recomputation from the two stored manifests.
An unchanged estate snapshot may still be appended at a later asOf; its transition diff records all apps unchanged while the manifest hash may differ because asOf is part of the snapshot.
Timeline entries are append-only operational audit history; contract/verifier code are canonical-registry pinned.
The timeline mutates no reviewed, deployment, review, candidate, checklist or certification state.
nonClaims: The first timeline entry establishes the beginning of recorded timeline history, not the beginning of the estate itself.
A transition timestamp shows when the later snapshot was recorded, not necessarily the exact instant an underlying real-world change occurred.
A changed transition is neutral recorded-state history, not a severity or cause judgement.
